cards.title: Re-entry: north flow
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Beach Line Departures/Shamrock Re-entry
instructions: Maintain 2,500' until you are BOTH cleared for re-entry AND past the beach line
Then descend to 1,000' MSL, parallel the beach line at 1 WTD at 240 KIAS, and join the Southern Arrival
cards.source: Binder, p. 17; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 62–65.
